subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: monthly tokens + peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Harris <emma.harris@payfast.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification — monthly token volume & peak TPS (recap)

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about PayFast's user assist workload. Per our call, I wanted to capture the key sizing inputs so we can recommend the most cost-effective hosted API configuration and give you a clear $/1M token target. Please confirm anything I got wrong or missing: 

- Primary use cases: contextual chat assistance + post-transaction summaries (low-latency responses for end users).
- Expected average tokens per request: ~120 tokens (you mentioned 80–150).
- Expected monthly token volume (best guess): 50M–150M tokens / month (likely start ~50M, growth to 100–150M in 6–12 months).
- Peak concurrency: 6–10 requests/sec during morning spike (short bursts ~15–30 minutes).
- Average RPS: ~0.5 req/s outside spikes.
- Budget range (monthly): $8k–$28k (flexible depending on unit price & SLA).
- Target unit economics you mentioned: preferable pricing near $15–$25 per 1M tokens.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the above numbers (especially average tokens/request and the expected 50M–150M monthly range).
2) I’ll run a quick cost calc with Redwood hosted rate tiers and propose an initial pilot configuration (recommended model family + estimated $/1M tokens and expected monthly bill).
3) If the numbers look good, we can spin up a two-week pilot with traffic shaping to validate latency and unit economics.

I attached a quick usage_estimates workbook — fill in any exact averages you have and send back. Also attaching a draft SOW for a pilot so legal can review in parallel if you’re comfortable.

Thanks — I’ll wait for your confirmation and the updated numbers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: PayFast_usage_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Emma Harris <emma.harris@payfast.com>

Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@payfast.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-17T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification — monthly token volume & peak TPS (recap)

Hi Ben — thanks for the recap and the materials. Confirming the numbers from our side: 

- Avg tokens/request: we typically see 90–140 tokens; you can use 120 as a planning number.
- Expected monthly tokens: initial month ~60M, then ramp to ~120M within 6 months. We also have an optimistic roadmap scenario hitting 200M+ in year two but not for the pilot.
- Peak concurrency: 8 req/s sustained for ~20 mins during the morning window; rarer bursts to 12 req/s for 2–3 minutes. Averaged daily RPS ~0.6.
- Budget: initial pilot budget of $10k/month; for production we can expand to $20k–$30k depending on unit cost and SLA.
- Target $/1M tokens: our finance lead prefers <$20/1M if possible, $15 is ideal.

A couple of notes/asks: 
- Can you show a quick cost calc for the 60M and 120M scenarios with: (a) $20/1M tokens, (b) $15/1M tokens, and (c) Redwood's standard hosted list price? Include estimated peak TPS sizing (ops and tokens/sec) and latency SLO implications.
- We will need standard SOC 2 evidence before production; Marissa — can you flag the security packet for Emma?

Sending the completed tab in the attached workbook with slightly more granular session length distributions.

Cheers,
Emma Harris
Head of Product Operations | PayFast Inc
emma.harris@payfast.com

Attachments: PayFast_usage_estimates.xlsx (updated)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Harris <emma.harris@payfast.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@payfast.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification — monthly token volume & peak TPS (recap)

Thanks Emma — this is super-helpful. I ran the three quick scenarios (ballpark) — summarized below. I’ll attach a short calc for transparency.

Assumptions: avg tokens/request = 120; month = 30 days; peak concurrency 8 req/s (short bursts to 12).

Scenario A (60M tokens / mo):
- At $20 per 1M tokens => 60 * $20 = $1,200 total? Wait — correction: math check — $20 per 1M tokens means 60 * $20 = $1,200. (This looks low; double-checking units below.)
- Clarification: Redwood bills per 1M tokens. 60M tokens => 60 * price_per_1M.

Scenario breakdown exact: (attached calc)
- 60M tokens @ $20/1M = $1,200 / month
- 60M tokens @ $15/1M = $900 / month
- Redwood hosted standard list price (example): $30/1M => 60 * $30 = $1,800 / month

Scenario B (120M tokens / mo):
- $20/1M => $2,400 / month
- $15/1M => $1,800 / month
- $30/1M => $3,600 / month

Peak sizing notes (concurrency & tokens/sec):
- Average tokens/sec (60M/mo): 60,000,000 / 2,592,000s ≈ 23 tokens/sec => with 120 tokens/request => avg RPS ≈ 0.19.
- Peak tokens/sec (8 req/s * 120 tokens) = 960 tokens/sec.
- For 120M/mo, peak tokens/sec same per-request assumptions; cost scales linearly.

Important pricing context / ask: those per-1M numbers above are unit-only and do not include any volume discounts, reserved capacity, or additional SLA charges. Based on your budget guidance, I’ll ask Marissa and our pricing team to scope a targeted proposal that can get you into the <$20/1M band for the 120M case with a pilot commitment.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben -> propose pilot rate card and model family by end of week.
2) We run two-week pilot (60M/mo equivalent throttled) so you can validate latency and costs under realistic spikes.
3) Security packet + SOC 2 evidence will be prepared by Marissa.

Marissa — can you confirm if we can offer a pilot price near $15–$20/1M for the 60–120M window (short-term pilot price) and advise on any required discount thresholds? Also confirm whether this stays on hosted API or we should discuss Redwood Dedicated if PayFast prefers more predictable throughput and a bumped SLA.

Thanks — attaching the cost_calc_20260917.xlsx (same workbook with calculations).

Best,
Ben

---
Attachments: cost_calc_20260917.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Pricing ask for PayFast — pilot pricing guidance

Marissa — quick internal note on PayFast (RDW-4571):

Recap: PayFast expects 60M initial tokens/month, ramp to 120M within 6 months. Peak bursts ~8–12 req/s, avg tokens/request ~120. They want sub-$20/1M if possible; pilot budget ~$10k/month.

Questions for pricing ops:
- Can we offer a pilot list price of $15/1M for first 60M (2–4 week pilot) and $18/1M for months 1–3 post-pilot with a 3–6 month review?
- If not, what threshold (token/mo or committed $) gets them into the $15–18/1M tier?
- Any concerns about exposing hosted API to bursts at 12 req/s for short periods — or should we recommend Redwood Dedicated for predictable latency/SLA?

I’ll hold on the pilot SOW signature until we have confirmed pricing. PayFast is motivated to move quickly so any quick guidance appreciated.

Thanks — Ben
